body: SLICE 5 MUTATION-SIGNATURE SUPPLEMENT under the chiefs new ruling. Thus none is a blanket-red compile break. Exact logs: /tmp/storymodel4s-slice5-mutant-document-isolated.log, /tmp/storymodel4s-slice5-mutant-interview-isolated.log, /tmp/storymodel4s-slice5-mutant-acquire-isolated.log.
